LanguageData.CC_R3Rain_Rite: The {NAME} are dancing round their fire to call the rain, and will do it every evening until it comes.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rain_RiteUp: The {NAME} are working at their gear by the fire to send something up into the clouds, and will do it every evening until the rain comes.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rain_SkyLine: The sky isn't theirs to call down, whatever they think.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rain_RainedUnpaid: It is raining on the colony's land, and the {NAME} are out of their tents cheering. They are packing up to go, and say it was their doing.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rain_RainedPaid: It is raining on the colony's land, and the {NAME} are cheering at their fire. {A_nameDef} is carrying the promised {COUNT} silver out to them, and they are packing up to go.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rain_RainedNoFee: It is raining on the colony's land, and the {NAME} came for their {COUNT} silver, but the colony hasn't got it or nobody is free to carry it out. They are packing up, not pleased.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rain_FeeImpact: {0} silver carried out to them if it rains after their rite; nothing now
LanguageData.CC_R3Dye_Done: {A_nameDef}'s {THING} has come out of the {NAME}'s vat, and {X_nameDef} has hung it by the fire to dry for a moment before handing it back.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dye_Refund: {A_nameDef} never came to have {A_possessive} clothes dyed, so the {NAME} are sending the {COUNT} silver back to the gate.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dye_Busy: Someone of the colony is already at their vats.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dye_Nothing: Nothing they wear would take the dye.
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_Mark_Healer: a healer who knows too much about herbs
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_Mark_Sensitive: one who feels what others don't
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_Mark_Xenotype: one who is not born as other people are
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_Mark_Psylink: one with powers of the mind
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_NoSuspect: There is nobody here they suspect.
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_Impact: {0} walks to their fire and is questioned there for an hour; a good talker is likelier to be let go
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_Cleared: The {NAME} questioned {A_nameDef} at their fire for an hour, and {X_nameDef} has said there is no mark on {A_objective}. They will go in the morning.
LanguageData.CC_R3Witch_Named: The {NAME} questioned {A_nameDef} at their fire for an hour, and {X_nameDef} has called {A_objective} a witch. They are packing up to go and tell it on the road.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rags_Nothing: Nothing in the stores is worn out enough.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rags_Label: the worn-out things for the rag-and-bone men
LanguageData.CC_R3Rags_Impact: {0} worn-out things (clothes and weapons too far gone, and slag) carried out to their camp
LanguageData.CC_R3Dice_LedgerLine: Silver that comes from dice goes back to the dice.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dice_Refund: {A_nameDef} never sat down at the {NAME}'s fire, so they are sending the {COUNT} silver stake back to the gate.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dice_Busy: Someone of the colony is already at their fire.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dice_Impact: {0} plays an evening at their fire with the stake: it may come back doubled, or not at all
LanguageData.CC_R3Dice_Won: {A_nameDef} won at the {NAME}'s fire tonight, and {X_nameDef} is bringing {COUNT} silver to the colony's gate with a sour face.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dice_Lost: {A_nameDef} lost the {COUNT} silver at the {NAME}'s fire tonight, and is walking back with empty pockets.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dice_Caught: {A_nameDef} caught the {NAME}'s loaded dice. {X_nameDef} is bringing the stake, {COUNT} silver, back to the gate, and the camp is in a bad mood.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dog_NoneLeft: They have no dog left to sell.
LanguageData.CC_R3Dog_Impact: The youngest of their dogs is the colony's, and keeps at {PAWN}'s heels for a day
LanguageData.CC_R3Rats_Chasing: The rat-catcher's dog is off across the colony's land after the rats.
LanguageData.CC_R3Rats_Clear: The rat-catcher's dog has cleared the colony's land of rats.
LanguageData.CC_R3Way_NoDrawings: They have no drawings to sell.
